description: This Java class 'SavingsAccountRequestFactory' provides static factory methods to create pre-configured request objects related to savings account operations such as account creation, approval, activation, deposit, and withdrawal within the Apache Fineract project. It encapsulates common setup details for savings account requests used in testing scenarios. The class includes constants for default values like date formats, locale, product IDs, and transaction amounts, and offers convenience methods to generate request objects with these defaults.

classes.name: SavingsAccountRequestFactory
